meta.note: ~30s spoken recaps per Grand Prix, color-led, fact-checked against f1.json (results) and media sources (F1.com, Sky, ESPN, The Race, Motorsport.com, Wikipedia). Keyed by round.

1.recap: Formula One's new-rules era began at Albert Park, and it began badly for the home fans: Australia's own Oscar Piastri crashed on the way to the grid and never started his home race, while Nico Hülkenberg's Audi was wheeled away with a technical failure before the lights. George Russell controlled the race from pole for a Mercedes one-two with Kimi Antonelli second, Charles Leclerc third. But the main talking point was the cars themselves — several drivers complained the new energy-deployment machines made overtaking feel artificial. The standout on track was Max Verstappen, recovering from twentieth to sixth and grabbing the fastest lap.

2.recap: Shanghai served up chaos before a wheel turned in anger. Four cars failed to start — most sensationally both McLarens, Norris and Piastri stopped by separate electrical faults, the team's first double non-start in over twenty years, and Piastri's second in a row after his Australia crash. Williams and Audi lost cars too, leaving the third row empty and just eighteen starters. From pole, Kimi Antonelli led almost throughout and set the fastest lap on his way to victory — at nineteen, the second-youngest Grand Prix winner in history and the first Italian to win since 2006. 'I'm about to cry,' he admitted. George Russell made it a Mercedes one-two in second, and Lewis Hamilton completed the podium with his first rostrum for Ferrari.

3.recap: Suzuka wasn't the procession the result suggests. Kimi Antonelli buried his pole start with heavy wheelspin, tumbling to sixth and handing Oscar Piastri the lead. Then Oliver Bearman's Haas hit the barriers at Spoon in a heavy fifty-G impact — he was unhurt — and the safety car it brought out swung the race Antonelli's way. Once ahead his pace was in a different league, and he cruised to a second win in a row, fastest lap included, becoming at nineteen the youngest driver ever to lead the championship. Piastri recovered to finish second, while the real scrap was for third — Charles Leclerc going around the outside at Turn One to hold off George Russell.

4.recap: Miami had drama at both ends. On the opening lap Antonelli, Verstappen and Leclerc went three-wide into Turn One; Verstappen spun a full three-sixty at Turn Two but gathered it up and continued, and moments later Pierre Gasly was flipped into the barriers after contact with Lawson. From pole, Kimi Antonelli won it in the pit lane: Mercedes undercut Lando Norris, who spent the closing laps within a second but never found a way past. 'I'm gutted — I think a win was possible,' said Norris, who'd won Saturday's sprint and set the fastest lap for nothing. Oscar Piastri completed the podium in third — and only after Charles Leclerc lost a place on it to a twenty-second track-limits penalty, tumbling from third to eighth.

5.recap: Montreal looked set to be George Russell's. He'd taken pole, won Saturday's sprint, and was leading, trading it wheel-to-wheel with his own teammate Kimi Antonelli — until, a third of the way in, his Mercedes suffered a catastrophic battery failure. Russell parked it, pounded his fists on the car and climbed out, later investigated for throwing his head rest onto the track. That handed Antonelli a fourth straight win, fastest lap included, ahead of Lewis Hamilton second and Max Verstappen third. The reliability toll spread down the field: Norris's gearbox failed, Alonso's seat collapsed inside the car, and Pérez's suspension gave way.

6.recap: Monaco unravelled — and the track itself was part of the story. The newly-resurfaced final corner began breaking up under the cars, pitching first Lance Stroll and then home favourite Charles Leclerc into the wall; Leclerc blamed his brakes over the radio as his home race ended in the barriers. A red flag halted things while marshals patched the tarmac. Max Verstappen was out almost immediately, stalling at the start. Through it all Kimi Antonelli was unruffled — pole, fastest lap, victory. Lewis Hamilton came home second. But the saga ran for days: Pierre Gasly finished third for Alpine, was stripped of the podium for a pit-lane penalty, then had it restored on appeal when the timing data proved wrong.

7.recap: Barcelona delivered the season's most emotional day: Lewis Hamilton won for the first time in Ferrari red, nearly two years since his last victory and, at forty-one, the oldest winner in over half a century. He'd beaten pole-sitter George Russell with an aggressive Ferrari strategy timed around a mid-race virtual safety car, and set the fastest lap to underline it, then completed an all-British podium with Russell second and Norris third — the first since nineteen-sixty-eight. 'Grazie to everyone at Ferrari, to Fred for believing in me,' Hamilton said. Even rivals warmed to it — Russell called him 'the Lewis I remember growing up.' The sting came late: championship leader Kimi Antonelli, running second, was stopped by an engine failure just four laps from home.

8.recap: The Red Bull Ring gave the home crowd plenty to cheer, but not the win. Max Verstappen had crashed in qualifying and started fifth, yet carved through the order and, on fresher tyres late, reeled in pole-sitter George Russell — only to run out of road, finishing just over a second behind in second. Russell held on for his first win since the season opener, reigniting his title fight with teammate Kimi Antonelli, who took third, set the fastest lap, and nearly snatched second on the final lap. Both Cadillacs retired with overheating brakes. 'Incredible to be back on the top step,' Russell said. 'I'm going to enjoy this one.'

9.recap: Silverstone had twist after twist. Kimi Antonelli started from pole, won the sprint, set the fastest lap and was leading — then clipped a kerb at Copse, broke his front wheel shield and, with a penalty on top, dropped out of the points. Charles Leclerc pounced for a redemptive win: his first at Silverstone, Ferrari's two-hundred-and-fiftieth, ending a long drought. 'Tough times never last, only tough people last,' he said. The finish was strange, though — Verstappen crashed out at Stowe, and a Race Control software error muddied the final-lap restart, so the race simply ended behind the safety car. George Russell finished second and Lewis Hamilton third to complete the podium for the home crowd.

10.recap: Spa stayed dry despite the threatening clouds, and it produced a proper fight. From pole, Kimi Antonelli lost the lead to Max Verstappen through Eau Rouge on lap one, took it back up the hill, then lost it again when Ferrari used a virtual safety car to leapfrog Charles Leclerc ahead. Antonelli hunted him down and repassed on the Kemmel Straight to win, with Leclerc second and Verstappen third. Lando Norris, recovering from a grid penalty, set the fastest lap. The drive of the day, though, was Isack Hadjar's — from twenty-first to sixth on an odd strategy of two pit stops in two laps; he called it his best race yet. George Russell's race ended in the gravel after Lewis Hamilton understeered into him, a clash that earned Hamilton a five-second penalty.

11.recap: At the Hungaroring the story was McLaren's — and it cut both ways. Oscar Piastri pounced at Turn Two on the opening lap to lead and looked the likely winner, until a gearbox failure in the closing laps ended his race from second. He'd already fumed at being clattered by a lapped Carlos Sainz, a clash he called 'unacceptable.' Teammate Lando Norris, insisting over the radio he was quicker, converted pole and clear-air pace into McLaren's first win of the season. Max Verstappen took second with what many rated the overtake of the year on Hamilton, while Kimi Antonelli climbed from seventh to third. Charles Leclerc, fourth at the flag, set the fastest lap.

12.recap: Zandvoort said goodbye with drama. On lap one, Max Verstappen dipped a wheel onto the white line at the final banked corner and clattered the wall at his home race — he was unhurt, but out, and the red flags flew. At the restart Kimi Antonelli launched beautifully and dived past pole-sitter Lando Norris into Turn One to lead for Mercedes. Norris was relentless, though: he reeled Antonelli back in the final third and retook the lead to win by over eleven seconds — a second victory in a row. Antonelli held on for second, George Russell third, the Mercedes pair flanking the McLaren. Charles Leclerc took the fastest lap, and Russell had won Saturday's sprint. Antonelli left the Netherlands still leading the championship.

13.recap: Monza belonged to Kimi Antonelli. He had qualified seventh, then a grid penalty dropped him to nineteenth — and the tifosi's afternoon began badly, Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton touching at Turn Two, Leclerc out after a single lap. A red flag stopped the race on lap three, and it restarted from the grid. From nineteenth, Antonelli picked the field apart, took the lead, and then the fastest lap too, a 1:23.504. He won by three point eight seconds from George Russell for a Mercedes one–two, with Max Verstappen third. Pierre Gasly had put Alpine on pole and came home seventh. Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri raced each other to the flag for fourth, two tenths apart. “Forza Kimi,” his engineer said on the slow-down lap — an Italian, winning at Monza. He leaves leading the championship by sixty-six points.

14.recap: Madrid's first Grand Prix was decided in a thirty-second window Lando Norris never saw coming. He led from pole and built six seconds on the field, untouchable — until Lance Stroll stopped with brake trouble and the virtual safety car came out moments after Norris had passed the pit entry. Kimi Antonelli dived in and changed tyres almost for free. Norris pitted once the neutralisation had ended, lost the race doing it, and fought back to third. Max Verstappen took second, George Russell the fastest lap. Lewis Hamilton had been gone since lap six, his radio saying it plainly: no brakes. Antonelli refused to dress it up afterwards — “it doesn't feel as good, because I think Lando today deserved to win.” He leaves Madrid eighty-one points clear.

15.recap: Baku gave George Russell a comfortable lead and then took it away twice. He had put his Mercedes on pole by eight tenths, the biggest margin of the year, and controlled the first half until Alex Albon's Williams found the wall and brought out the safety car. At the restart Franco Colapinto locked up into turn one, collecting his Alpine team-mate Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris, and out it came again. From there it was Russell against Max Verstappen, a few tenths apart to the flag; Verstappen pulled alongside on the final straight and came up one tenth short. Isack Hadjar completed a Red Bull double podium. Liam Lawson, tagged by his own team-mate, summed up the chaos: “I love getting taken out by my team mate. That's pretty sick.” Russell also set the fastest lap, while Kimi Antonelli, sixteenth after a qualifying crash, recovered to fifth and leaves Baku sixty-six points clear.

16.recap: Sepang's return to Formula 1 made everyone wait. A tropical deluge delayed the start, then the start procedure was suspended as cars lost drive on the formation lap, and the race finally got going in slippery, mixed conditions. Max Verstappen, on pole, lost out to both Mercedes into turn one, then picked off Kimi Antonelli and George Russell either side of a safety car for Valtteri Bottas's spin, and from there he was in control, adding the fastest lap on the very last lap. That safety car was the moment to swap intermediates for slicks. Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc had gambled on slicks from the start, dropped towards the back, and charged back to third and fourth. Russell's race ended late, his Mercedes stopping on the start-finish straight behind the final safety car. It is Red Bull's first win of the season, and Antonelli's second place takes his lead to eighty-four points.

tr.fr: Le retour de Sepang en Formule 1 s'est fait attendre. Un déluge tropical a retardé le départ, puis la procédure de départ a été suspendue car plusieurs voitures perdaient de la puissance dans le tour de formation, et la course s'est enfin élancée sur une piste glissante, aux conditions changeantes. Parti de la pole, Max Verstappen s'est fait passer par les deux Mercedes au premier virage, puis a repris Kimi Antonelli et George Russell de part et d'autre d'une voiture de sécurité provoquée par le tête-à-queue de Valtteri Bottas. Dès lors, il a contrôlé la course, signant même le meilleur tour dans l'ultime boucle. Cette voiture de sécurité était le moment idéal pour passer des pneus intermédiaires aux slicks. Lewis Hamilton et Charles Leclerc avaient parié sur les slicks dès le départ, ont reculé vers le fond du peloton, puis sont remontés jusqu'aux troisième et quatrième places. La course de Russell s'est arrêtée en fin d'épreuve, sa Mercedes immobilisée sur la ligne droite des stands derrière la dernière voiture de sécurité. C'est la première victoire de la saison pour Red Bull, et sa deuxième place porte l'avance d'Antonelli à quatre-vingt-quatre points.
tr.it: Il ritorno di Sepang in Formula 1 si è fatto attendere. Un nubifragio tropicale ha ritardato la partenza, poi la procedura di partenza è stata sospesa perché diverse vetture perdevano potenza nel giro di formazione, e la gara è finalmente partita su un asfalto scivoloso, in condizioni miste. Max Verstappen, scattato dalla pole, è stato superato da entrambe le Mercedes alla prima curva, poi ha ripreso Kimi Antonelli e George Russell prima e dopo una safety car causata dal testacoda di Valtteri Bottas, e da lì ha controllato la gara, firmando anche il giro più veloce proprio all'ultimo giro. Quella safety car è stata il momento giusto per passare dalle intermedie alle slick. Lewis Hamilton e Charles Leclerc avevano scommesso sulle slick fin dal via, sono scivolati in fondo al gruppo e hanno rimontato fino al terzo e al quarto posto. La gara di Russell si è chiusa nel finale, con la sua Mercedes ferma sul rettilineo di partenza dietro l'ultima safety car. È la prima vittoria stagionale della Red Bull, e il secondo posto porta il vantaggio di Antonelli in classifica a ottantaquattro punti.
tr.es: El regreso de Sepang a la Fórmula 1 se hizo esperar. Un diluvio tropical retrasó la salida; después se suspendió el procedimiento de salida porque varios coches perdían potencia en la vuelta de formación, y la carrera arrancó por fin en condiciones mixtas y resbaladizas. Max Verstappen, desde la pole, cedió ante los dos Mercedes en la primera curva, pero superó a Kimi Antonelli y a George Russell antes y después de un coche de seguridad provocado por el trompo de Valtteri Bottas, y desde ahí controló la carrera, con vuelta rápida incluida en el último giro. Ese coche de seguridad fue el momento de cambiar los neumáticos intermedios por los de seco. Lewis Hamilton y Charles Leclerc habían apostado por los slicks desde la salida, cayeron hacia el fondo y remontaron hasta la tercera y la cuarta posición. La carrera de Russell terminó en el tramo final: su Mercedes se detuvo en la recta principal detrás del último coche de seguridad. Es la primera victoria de la temporada para Red Bull, y el segundo puesto de Antonelli amplía su ventaja a ochenta y cuatro puntos.
tr.de: Sepangs Rückkehr in die Formel 1 ließ auf sich warten. Ein tropischer Wolkenbruch verzögerte den Start, dann wurde das Startprozedere unterbrochen, weil mehrere Autos in der Formationsrunde Leistung verloren, und schließlich ging das Rennen bei rutschigen, wechselhaften Bedingungen los. Max Verstappen verlor von der Pole aus in Kurve eins beide Mercedes, schnappte sich Kimi Antonelli und George Russell aber vor und nach einer Safety-Car-Phase nach dem Dreher von Valtteri Bottas und hatte das Rennen danach im Griff, samt schnellster Runde in der allerletzten Runde. Diese Safety-Car-Phase war der Moment, von Intermediates auf Slicks zu wechseln. Lewis Hamilton und Charles Leclerc hatten schon beim Start auf Slicks gesetzt, fielen weit zurück und stürmten dann auf die Plätze drei und vier nach vorn. Russells Rennen endete spät: Sein Mercedes blieb hinter dem letzten Safety-Car auf der Start-Ziel-Geraden stehen. Es ist Red Bulls erster Saisonsieg, und mit Platz zwei baut Antonelli seinen Vorsprung auf vierundachtzig Punkte aus.
tr.ja: セパンでのF1復活レースは、待たされる展開となった。熱帯の豪雨でスタートが遅れ、さらにフォーメーションラップで複数のマシンがパワーを失ったためスタート手順が中断。レースはようやく、滑りやすいミックスコンディションの中で始まった。ポールポジションのマックス・フェルスタッペンは1コーナーでメルセデスの2台に先行を許したが、バルテリ・ボッタスのスピンによるセーフティカーの前後でキミ・アントネッリとジョージ・ラッセルを抜き返し、その後はレースを完全にコントロール。最終ラップにはファステストラップも記録した。このセーフティカーこそ、インターミディエイトからスリックへ交換する絶好のタイミングだった。スタートからスリックに賭けたルイス・ハミルトンとシャルル・ルクレールは一時後方まで後退したものの、3位と4位まで追い上げた。ラッセルは終盤、最後のセーフティカーの後ろでメインストレートにマシンを止め、レースを終えた。レッドブルにとって今季初勝利となり、2位のアントネッリはリードを84ポイントに広げた。
tr.zh: 雪邦重返F1的这场比赛，让所有人等了很久。一场热带暴雨推迟了发车，随后多辆赛车在暖胎圈中失去动力，发车程序被暂停，比赛最终在湿滑、干湿混合的条件下开始。杆位出发的马克斯·维斯塔潘在一号弯被两辆梅赛德斯超越，随后在瓦尔特利·博塔斯打滑引发的安全车前后，先后反超基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔，此后完全掌控比赛，并在最后一圈刷新最快圈速。那次安全车正是从半雨胎换成干地胎的最佳时机。刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔从发车起就押注干地胎，一度落到车阵后方，随后一路追回第三和第四。拉塞尔的比赛在最后阶段结束，他的梅赛德斯在最后一次安全车期间停在了发车直道上。这是红牛本赛季的首场胜利，安东内利凭借第二名将积分领先优势扩大到84分。
